response.original_title: О! Поймал Атом Солнца. Олег Табаков
response.overview: Through the living testimonies of colleagues, students, and unique archival materials, the film reveals Tabakov’s path as an actor, teacher, artistic director, reformer of the theatrical process, and tireless creator. The film is built on associative drama, where the metaphor of the “atom of the sun” takes on particular significance — as a spark, as the inner energy that Tabakov carried within himself and that he knew how to inspire in others.
response.title: Oh! I’ve Caught the Sun Atom. Oleg Tabakov
